segment.description: Mossy Creek in Jefferson County — the small farmland creek through Jefferson City where TWRA's winter trout program stocks on and around the Carson-Newman University campus (program reach per the stocking event documentation). Identity verified by county: all 'Mossy Creek' rows in TWRA's 2026 schedule are Jefferson County ('Mossy Creek (NEW)'); the Robertson County namesake does not exist in the schedule, and Virginia's Mossy Creek is a different state. TDEC lists a separate Mossy Creek impairment unit (TN06010104004T_2600, 9.08 mi, Jefferson County, HUC 06010104 Holston).
segment.boundaries: Jefferson County creek; documented stocking reach is the Carson-Newman University campus segment in downtown Jefferson City; catalog gives no formal boundaries.

coldSource.notes: No cold-water source documented. Catalog: 'Small farmland creek; flows track rain and groundwater closely.' TDEC's 2026 303(d) list records Mossy Creek (Jefferson County, 9.08 mi) impaired for SEDIMENTATION/SILTATION (High, municipal/urbanized source), ALTERATION IN STREAM-SIDE VEGETATIVE COVERS (Medium), NUTRIENTS (Low), and ESCHERICHIA COLI (sanitary sewer overflows and urban sources) — an agricultural/urban valley creek. The winter-only stocking design itself is TWRA's cold-season program: the STMP describes the winter trout program as placing 'events... near town centers on public property' to recruit new anglers where trout opportunity is otherwise limited.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found. Program design is winter put-and-take: 300 Rainbow Trout released on the Carson-Newman campus Nov 21, 2025 with ~600 more planned for December and January, matching TWRA's plan statement that hatchery-supported waters 'are primarily warmwater habitats that cannot support trout year round'.

wildPopulation.detail: Not on TWRA's wild trout stream list (trout regulations page checked); no wild trout record found in any agency source.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: A brand-new winter put-and-take site (300 Buffalo Springs rainbows stocked on the Carson-Newman campus 11/21/2025, ~600 more Dec-Jan; TWRA named 'Mossy Creek in Jefferson County' among 40+ winter program locations) on a 303(d)-listed sedimentation/E. coli-impaired creek that TWRA's own plan places in the class of 'primarily warmwater habitats that cannot support trout year round'.
